deadline.value: Applied Biology applicants must have all documents in by February 15 for full fall consideration.
deadline.quote: All required documents are due to the Office of Graduate Admissions by February 15 for full fall consideration.

also.quote: Applied Biology, Chemistry and Polymer Science Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) Applicants

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required for admission, though a faculty sponsor may ask for it during evaluation.
gre_general.quote: The Graduate Record Exam (GRE) is not required for admission but may be requested by a faculty sponsor during the evaluation process.

toefl_min.value: The Applied Biology Ph.D. requires a TOEFL score of at least 90, higher than the university minimum.
toefl_min.quote: A minimum score of 90 is required on the TOEFL

supervisor.value: Admission depends on a faculty sponsor who agrees to supervise and writes a letter of sponsorship.
supervisor.quote: Admission to the Applied Biology Ph.D. program is contingent on securing a faculty sponsor and obtaining a letter of sponsorship from that faculty member.

funding.value: The department says it strives to fund all admitted PhD students through assistantships that depend on availability.
funding.quote: UMass Lowell strives to provide financial support for all admitted Ph.D. students.

entry_route.value: First-year applicants need a bachelor's or master's in biology or a related field with a 3.000 GPA.
entry_route.quote: First year and transfer students must show evidence of having earned a Bachelors or Master’s degree in Biology or a related discipline

gre_subject.value: No subject test applies to biology, and the page does not mention one.

notes: Umbrella program: Applied Biology with options including Biomedical Science, Developmental & Evolutionary Biology, Quantitative Biology & Biophysics and Cellular & Molecular Biology. The Biology department also lists a Biomedical Engineering & Biotechnology PhD, not researched further.
